notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer, Palladium Myr and Gold Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Gold Myr by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.
